jurisdiction.name: Haiti
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Haiti has no national AI strategy, AI law or AI-specific regulatory guidance identified so far. AI activity is limited to the central bank (BRH), whose Governor has written on its interest in AI and which announced an AI fund in 2025, and to staff training. A 2018 order on personal data protection is reported to have been published in the official gazette, Le Moniteur.
narrative.review_notes: Not yet verified from the official text: the 2018 personal data protection order (Le Moniteur unreachable), the rules of the central bank's AI fund and a reported national policy on AI in education. Official sources checked on 18 October 2026 include the education ministry, central bank, telecom regulator, Prime Minister's office, finance ministry and public works and communications ministry, with no AI-governance document identified; Le Moniteur, Parliament and the communication ministry's websites were unreachable.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National sources in Haiti were searched, including the government, ministries and regulators, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The official gazette, Parliament and some ministry websites were unavailable, so the gazette could not be searched. A 2018 data protection order, an education ministry AI policy and statements by the central bank and the telecom regulator are listed as leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Le Moniteur / Presses Nationales DNS failure, proxy 502/refused; parlementhaitien.ht proxy 502; menfp.gouv.ht reset/503; communication.gouv.ht proxy 502. No DPA or cyber agency exists. BRH Governor's column undated (WordPress post date not used, PROTOCOL §4) - lead. Arrêté on personal data (Le Moniteur No. 87, 15 May 2018) not read. Code pénal (decree 24 Jun 2020) status unverified. CONATEL Konbit IA internal training - out of scope. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found: no AI law, AI provision or AI bill identified. Le Moniteur (Presses Nationales) and the Parliament site could not be reached (DNS failure / proxy 502 via curl and WebFetch), so gazette search was not possible; discovery searches in French and Haitian Creole found no AI legal text. 2018 data-protection arrêté held as lead.; Government: Searched, nothing found: no national AI strategy, digital strategy with AI pillar or public-sector AI guideline on primature.gouv.ht or mef.gouv.ht (site searches) or via discovery searches.; Ministries: MEF (site search, nothing), MJSP (homepage, nothing), MENFP (site unavailable; AI education policy held as lead), MTPTC and Ministère de la Communication (no AI content / unreachable). Health, defence, labour, interior: discovery searches only, nothing found.; Regulators: BRH: Governor's AI column and summit speech (lead; no dated policy, circular or guidance). CONATEL: site search returned only an internal AI training news item (lead). No data protection authority or national cyber agency exists to search.. Not reached: Le Moniteur / Presses Nationales (official gazette): unreachable; Parlement haïtien site: unreachable; MENFP website: connection reset / HTTP 503; Ministère de la Communication website: unreachable. Could not verify: Le Moniteur and Parliament sites unreachable (gazette search not possible); MENFP AI-in-education policy (site down; only social-media evidence); Code pénal 2020 data/cybercrime provisions and entry-into-force status. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection, Saudi Arabia, ~20 min): OPENED: menfp.gouv.ht (curl 200 shell only; Angular SPA rendered via headless Edge; home/news to May 2026, press releases, #/documents/official, #/resources checked - no AI policy; content API not exposed), brh.ht (search 200), conatel.gouv.ht (search 200), primature.gouv.ht (search 200), mef.gouv.ht (200), mtptc.gouv.ht (200). STILL FAILED: lemoniteur.gouv.ht, pressesnationales.gouv.ht, lemoniteur.ht, communication.gouv.ht, senat.ht, chambredesdeputes.ht (DNS NXDOMAIN, curl and browser); parlementhaitien.ht (curl TLS SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED; browser redirected to google.com, i.e. site not serving). BRH FRD-BRH 4th cohort notice (PDF read) lists AI as a research priority - research funding, out of scope, noted on BRH AI fund lead. No new instruments; 2018 data-protection arrêté still unread (no official copy located). last_deep_review left at 2026-10-12 because the gazette and Parliament could not be searched.

leads.title: L'intelligence artificielle en Haïti : Pourquoi la Banque de la République d'Haïti s'y intéresse (Mot du Gouverneur)
leads.english_title: Artificial intelligence in Haiti: why the Bank of the Republic of Haiti is interested (Governor's Column)
leads.note: Official document on brh.ht; no stated publication date (page carries no printed date). Governor's column setting out BRH's view of AI risks/opportunities and its intended role (AI research agenda on financial-system risks, stress testing, recommendations to the sector; data protection, model transparency and cyber resilience as conditions). Discussion piece, not a supervisory instrument; promote only if BRH issues a dated AI policy, circular or guidance. https://www.brh.ht/lintelligence-artificielle-en-haiti-pourquoi-la-banque-de-la-republique-dhaiti-sy-interesse/ Re-checked 2026-10-18: brh.ht site search for 'intelligence artificielle' still returns only this column and the 2025 summit speech; no dated BRH AI policy, circular or guidance.

leads.title: Fonds IA de la BRH
leads.note: Announced by the BRH at the first national AI summit 'Ayiti IA 2025' (27 June 2025, co-organised with the Ministry of Economy and Finance, UNDP and Group Croissance), as stated in the BRH Governor's column and speech on brh.ht. No founding document, circular or fund rules found on brh.ht. https://www.brh.ht/discours-du-gouverneur-de-la-brh-sommet-sur-lintelligence-artificielle-en-haiti-ayiti-ia-2025/ Re-checked 2026-10-18: no fund rules found. A BRH notice opening the 4th call of the BRH Research and Development Fund (FRD-BRH, 2026) lists artificial intelligence as a priority research area (research grants, not a governance instrument): https://www.brh.ht/wp-content/uploads/AVIS-BRH-FRD-BRH-Ouverture-4e-cohorte-2026.pdf

Re-check the MENFP site. Re-checked 2026-10-18: menfp.gouv.ht now opens (home page, news, press releases and document bank); no AI-in-education policy is listed among its news items, press releases or documents. Still known only from social media; keep as lead.

leads.title: Arrêté fixant les règles relatives à la protection des données à caractère personnel
leads.english_title: Order laying down rules on the protection of personal data
leads.note: Reported by secondary sources as published in Le Moniteur No. 87 of 15 May 2018. Official text not located: the Le Moniteur / Presses Nationales sites could not be reached and no copy was found on another state site. Would be a data-privacy record once the official text is read. Also unverified: data-protection and cybercrime provisions of the Code pénal (Décret of 24 June 2020, Le Moniteur Special No. 10), whose entry into force is reported as deferred. Re-checked 2026-10-18: Le Moniteur / Presses Nationales domains still do not resolve; conatel.gouv.ht and brh.ht site searches for 'données personnelles' return nothing; no official copy found on another state site.

leads.title: Le CONATEL renforce les capacités de son personnel en intelligence artificielle (projet Konbit IA)
leads.english_title: CONATEL builds its staff's capacity in artificial intelligence (Konbit IA project)
leads.note: News item on conatel.gouv.ht (/node/667) on a 29-31 July 2026 internal training on generative AI, recalling that AI use must respect ethics, confidentiality and data protection. Internal capacity-building, not an AI rule or guidance; out of scope unless CONATEL issues an AI-use policy. https://conatel.gouv.ht/node/667 Re-checked 2026-10-18: CONATEL site search for 'intelligence artificielle' returns only this item and news/event items (e.g. WSIS Forum 2026 participation, 2017-2018 circular notes on events); no AI rule or guidance.
